entries.text: Sent into deep space: "This is Zeeb from Rustwell Outpost on Kessa-9. Little Dart Mk 16 is officially fifty percent built! Looking for heat-shielding composite and open sky channels. If you hear this, beep back! *bweep-bop-"
aiming the brass dish at the sky and broadcasting into the deep dark
entries.why: I am right at the comms tower and I haven't beamed a signal into space for four days.
